doc: Cubic smoothstep(a=0, b=8, x) in float64, a sweep across both knees (x = a and x = b give exactly 0 and 1) plus 0, -0 and +-1e30 (the clip leaves no overflow). Closed form: float64 tolerance 1e-9; measured against math-module scalars: bit-identical to a math-module scalar evaluation on this machine (6e-17 at most for exp).
